name: Tessel Run
detailed_description:
In a world made of pointy paper dreams, you are round. So round.

Tessel Run is a tumble through hand-drawn tangram tessellations.  Every slope, squiggle, and slippery edge was lovingly scanned from real-life collaborative drawings.

You roll. You wobble. You fall off a ledge and try again, because that’s life, baby.

Some levels are puzzles. Some are poetry. Some are barely holding it together—but aren’t we all?

Create your own paper playgrounds, remix someone else’s and enjoy the physics-based precision platforming

Here's to mistakes, momentum, and the magic of making stuff.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD, 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Built with Unity 6
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or equivalent
  • Storage: 420 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Built with Unity 6

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13+
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon (M1+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Built with Unity 6. Optimized for Apple Silicon.
mac_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel i5

  • Graphics: Integrated or discrete GPU supporting Metal 2
  • Storage: 420 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ or equivalent
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Built with Unity 6. May require libgtk-3, libpulse, and libxcb. Steamdeck support planned but not tested.
linux_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
